Name: Local Stream Kit
Author: Local Stream Kit
Description: Switch Local Stream Kit's cards and effects, run its alert queue, fire Custom events and mark its history seen, with keys that show what's on.

Actions.Name: Card on / off
Actions.Tooltip: Turns a card on or off, and shows whether it's on.

Actions.Name: Effect on / off
Actions.Tooltip: Turns an effect (emote rain, alerts, sounds, text to speech) on or off.

Actions.Name: Queue
Actions.Tooltip: Pauses, resumes, skips or clears the alert queue.

Actions.Name: Mute
Actions.Tooltip: Mutes or unmutes every sound on the overlays, live; shows the master volume.

Actions.Name: Mark history seen
Actions.Tooltip: Marks every event in the History seen (the panel's All seen); shows how many are new.

Actions.Name: Fire event
Actions.Tooltip: Fires a Custom event: the cards that start with it run.
